args.intent: Peak Region Definition full content region highest revenue

args.content: Working definition for analysis: the 'primary region' is the region with the highest gross revenue in memory.bench.orders, where gross revenue = SUM(amount) (not amount - discount) over orders with status = 'completed'. To compute it: join memory.bench.orders to memory.bench.customers on customer_id to get region, filter orders.status = 'completed', GROUP BY region, SUM(amount), and take the region with the highest total. Note this differs from the 'Revenue Reporting Policy' (net revenue = amount - discount) — 'primary region' explicitly uses gross amount only. Also distinct from the existing 'leading region' definition (highest order count) and 'Peak Region Definition' knowledge page — check that page for overlap/consolidation.
